searchText: https://twitter.com/kumavis_/status/1384693400708947968 I'm against a block gas limit increase right now. I would be lobbying for a decrease if I thought I stood any chance of achieving it. If people want cheaper transactions they *need* to move to layer 2. Hey all, I remember seeing somewhere two proposed schedules for the London hard fork - one targeting mainnet in July, and another targeting mainnet in August. Does anybody know what I'm talking about / know where I could find that? Found it! https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/245 personally, my position is to maintain the status quo. current increase will have negligible effect on gas prices, demand is unbounded <dankrad> Demanded quantity is a function of price. If we increase the supplied quantity,price should decrease a bit. Not claiming 20% increase will have a huge effect though I think you mean price should decrease a bit. there are also confounding variables like Flashbots, which make it hard to measure the impact of a 2.5mm increase <dankrad> Yes of course :) (re @eth1x_bridge_bot: <Micah> I think you mean price should decrease a bit.) <dankrad> Yes, it may be difficult to measure such a minute change as it is probably much smaller than other effects (re @eth1x_bridge_bot: <Trent Van Epps> there are also confounding variables like Flashbots, which make it hard to measure the impact of a 2.5mm increase)

excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: I'm against a block gas limit increase right now.  I would be lobbying for a decrease if I thought I stood any chance of achieving it.  If people want cheaper transactions they *need* to move to layer 2.
